name: MonarchTextField
title: Input
summary: A text input with a label, helper text and an error message.
whenToUse: For one value typed by the user.
whenNotToUse: For a choice from a fixed list use radio rows or a Material 3 menu. For search use the Material 3 SearchBar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTextField(value: String, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, singleLine: Boolean = true, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, visualTransformation: VisualTransformation = VisualTransformation.None, keyboardOptions: KeyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions.Default, keyboardActions: KeyboardActions = KeyboardActions.Default, required: Boolean = false, successText: String? = null, prefix: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, suffix: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, minLines: Int = 1, maxLines: Int = if (singleLine) 1 else Int.MAX_VALUE, textStyle: TextStyle? = null, labelVisibility: MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility = MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility.Visible, requiredLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The text in the field.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new text.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the component.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label; it floats into the outline.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: An example shown while the field is empty and focused.

options.name: helperText
options.description: Guidance below the field.

options.name: errorText
options.description: When not null the field is in the error state and this replaces the helper text.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field can be focused and edited.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Selectable but not editable.

options.name: singleLine
options.description: One line that scrolls horizontally.

options.name: leadingIcon
options.description: An icon at the start.

options.name: trailingIcon
options.description: An icon at the end.

options.name: visualTransformation
options.description: For example PasswordVisualTransformation().

options.name: keyboardOptions
options.description: Keyboard type and IME action.

options.name: keyboardActions
options.description: What the IME action does.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: To observe focus and press.

options.name: required
options.description: An asterisk after the label and "required" after the TalkBack name.

options.name: successText
options.description: A confirmation below the field; puts the outline in the success color.

options.name: prefix
options.description: Content before the input, inside the outline.

options.name: suffix
options.description: Content after the input, such as a unit.

options.name: minLines
options.description: The smallest number of lines shown.

options.name: maxLines
options.description: The largest number of lines before the field scrolls.

options.name: textStyle
options.description: The style of the input text, for example monospace; null uses the body style.

options.name: labelVisibility
options.description: Hidden keeps the label as the TalkBack name only.

options.name: requiredLabel
options.description: Replaces the TalkBack name of a required field (monarch_textfield_required).

states.name: resting
states.description: Surface fill with the input border.

states.name: focused
states.description: The outline takes the focus ring color and the label moves into it.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle fill, disabled text, default border.

states.name: read only
states.description: Looks like resting; the text cannot be edited.

appearance: A surface-coloured field with the input border, which has at least 3:1 contrast against the surface in every theme. Focus uses the focus ring color, error the strong danger color.
platformNotes: The label floats into the outline, as in every Material 3 text field; on the web and iOS it is a separate line above the field. The web size option is not offered: the field has the Material height of 56dp.
accessibility: The label names the field for TalkBack.
The error text is exposed as the error of the field.
The field is at least 48dp high and grows with the font size setting.
A disabled field is announced as disabled.
Focus is shown by the outline in the focus ring color.
edgeCases: A long helper or error text wraps below the field.
Without a label the field has no name; give one, or a content description through modifier.
errorText = "" is still the error state.

examples.title: Sizes and states
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchTextField(value = small, onValueChange = { small = it }, label = "Small", placeholder = {{small}}, size = MonarchFieldSize.Small, labelVisibility = MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility.Hidden)
    MonarchTextField(value = standard, onValueChange = { standard = it }, label = "Default", placeholder = {{default}}, labelVisibility = MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility.Hidden)
    MonarchTextField(value = large, onValueChange = { large = it }, label = "Large", placeholder = {{large}}, size = MonarchFieldSize.Large, labelVisibility = MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility.Hidden)
    MonarchTextField(value = invalid, onValueChange = { invalid = it }, label = "Invalid", invalid = true, labelVisibility = MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility.Hidden)
    MonarchTextField(value = disabled, onValueChange = { disabled = it }, label = "Disabled", placeholder = {{disabled}}, enabled = false, labelVisibility = MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility.Hidden)
    MonarchTextField(value = notes, onValueChange = { notes = it }, label = "Notes", placeholder = {{notes}}, singleLine = false, minLines = 3, labelVisibility = MonarchTextFieldLabelVisibility.Hidden)
}

examples.title: Password
examples.code:
MonarchTextField(
    value = password,
    onValueChange = { password = it },
    label = "Password",
    visualTransformation = PasswordVisualTransformation(),
    keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Password),
)
